source: MASSIVE 1.1 pt-PT, allowed train/development only; extra OWN-PT lexical supervision explicitly admitted
representation: Unchanged AXSQ0009 lexical model/module16, 86272 neural coefficients. No new inference state, vocabulary, text substitution, codec, graph or semantic fact is deployed. Trained embedding values may change. No pretrained LLM, PyTorch or hidden remote service.
lexical_information: Only OWN-PT word-to-synset facts: lower-case exact single-word matches to the 4096-word frozen primary-train lexicon, all senses retained, 1123 unique undirected co-synset edges on957 words. Definitions/hypernyms not used. Source word facts83762, covered senses7406. Co-synset at word level is NOT unambiguous synonymy or proof of task-preserving substitution. Extra source information is not claimed equal to primary-only training.
learning: For each supervised sentence, after its ordinary online SGD heads, one shuffled lexical edge receives the gradient of 1/2||e_a-e_b||^2: both endpoints updated simultaneously at decaying base learning rate times lexical weight, independent of intent frequency balance. Independent RNG shuffles lexical edges without consuming primary initialization/shuffle/dropout RNG. Source edges are train-only and bounded50000; labels/words must match the learned vocabulary. Initial mode rejects graph+Adam/CNN/recurrent/collision-control/character/active-POS combinations. Zero weight must reproduce old number and update no edge.
controls: 0 zero-weight same graph; 1 weak0.1; 2 strong0.5; 3 strong0.5 degree-preserving rewired graph. Every word degree, node/edge count, same vocabulary and primary data preserved by negative graph control. Bounded double-edge swaps seed19374611:11230 accepted/11390 attempts,14 original edges retained. Not a uniform random-graph sampler. All policies fixed before task scores; single initialization, no statistical significance claim.
work: 4 fits x32 epochs x8526 sentences =1091328 primary presentations; active policies each272832 pair updates. Graph buffers/source JSON are additional training workspace and discarded before birth. CPU/RSS/energy must be measured separately, not inferred from the unchanged genome or elapsed training under concurrent tests.
preflight: Analytic symmetric pair gradient versus finite differences, untouched other rows, bounded failed update; zero-weight bytes/RNG unchanged, active counters, deterministic roundtrip, unknown/reversed/duplicate edges and unsupported combinations refused. Graph source parser/degree preservation/rewiring deterministic tests. Not independent language proof.
selection: Consumed-development exact count, then deployed neural coefficient count, then index. All failures retained. Original test and reserved workers untouched; PACIFIC question/answer annotations unused. No best-development score closes all seven M1 gates or authorizes M2.
method_limit: Inspired by established lexical regularization/retrofitting, not a reproduction of its offline update algorithm, an AXON invention, learned sense disambiguation, AGI, or proof of emergent unrestricted understanding.
